doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

title: Billy Kersands giving concerts for the Holy Family sisters
summary: Asked about music in Donaldsonville, she recalls Billy Kersands giving concerts at the Holy Family school, opening his mouth wide.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, what kind of music did you hear in Donaldsonville when you were growing up? Did they have dances there? Or?

Billika Sand. Did you hear Billika Sand? Sure. He used to come in. I went to the sisters of the Holy Family. She paid to him. Holy Family School out there. Holy Family Sisters from here. They had a school and that's where I went to school. And he used to give concerts for the sisters out there. Billika Sand. And who else used to come out there? Well, that was a main feature.
That was a main feature of him.
Oh, and Billika Sand would come out there. The whole countryside would go.

He'd open his mouth so wide. Open his mouth so wide. All the children would try to imitate him. And of course, the Holy Family Sisters always gave nice concerts. I used to bring practically all of them. All of the, all of the concerts. They always gave nice concerts. And, um, who else? I can't, I can't remember.
